Google Ads vs Meta Ads: Which Should a Local Business Use?

Compare Google Ads and Meta Ads by customer intent, creative needs, budget, lead handling and how local businesses should measure results.

This guide is intended to help business owners make a useful next decision. Check platform settings and legal requirements at the time you implement a recommendation.

The main difference is intent

Google Search Ads can reach people actively searching for a service. Meta Ads can introduce a message or offer to people based on available audience controls while they browse social content. Neither channel is always better; the decision depends on how customers discover the service and what the offer requires.

Consider the destination

Search ads need relevant landing pages, accurate details and a working call or enquiry route. Meta campaigns may use a website, instant form or WhatsApp conversation. Each destination needs a responsible person who can respond and record outcome.

Do not compare cost per result blindly

One channel may produce cheaper messages that are less qualified. Another may produce fewer but more relevant enquiries. Compare the cost of qualified leads and eventual sales where you can track those outcomes, and keep attribution windows and time periods clear.

Budget and creative requirements

Search budgets are shaped by keyword auctions and demand; Meta budgets are influenced by audience, creative, placements and objective. Both benefit from a clear offer and a way to measure what happened. A small budget usually needs a narrow test, not several campaigns competing for the same money.

Use the business's sales process

Ask how quickly the team can call back, what questions qualify a lead, and how to record results. If those steps are missing, both platforms can look ineffective even when people are responding.

Choose by evidence

Start with the channel that best matches the immediate goal and the business's capacity. Review actual results over an agreed period, then decide whether to continue, change or add another channel. No provider can honestly guarantee a fixed cost or lead volume before seeing the real campaign and offer.

How Hei Digi approaches this: start with the customer, keep business information accurate, measure actions in context and report what is known separately from what is assumed.
